resolved_text: Hugging Face said that Clément Delangue was its co-founder and chief executive officer in 2023. The company, led by Clément Delangue, expanded its open-source machine-learning platform and partnerships during the year.

Google LLC invested in Anthropic in October 2023 and committed up to two billion dollars. The company said the investment would deepen its cloud partnership with Anthropic while supporting development of safer artificial intelligence systems.

Anthropic developed Claude and introduced the artificial-intelligence assistant in March 2023. The startup described Claude as a conversational technology designed around helpfulness, honesty, and safety.

Microsoft Corporation invested one billion dollars in OpenAI in July 2019. The two companies partnered to build new Azure artificial-intelligence supercomputing technologies and commercialize advanced AI systems.

MSFT invested ten billion dollars in OpenAI in January 2023 through a multiyear partnership. Microsoft said the expanded investment would accelerate shared supercomputing research and deployment through Azure.

OpenAI developed GPT-4 and released the named multimodal artificial-intelligence technology in March 2023. The company reported that GPT-4 could accept image and text inputs and generate text outputs.

Meta Platforms developed Llama 2 and released the large language model in July 2023. Meta partnered with Microsoft to make the technology available through Azure and permitted research and commercial use under its license.

Meta developed Llama 3 and released the next generation of its openly available large language model in April 2024. The company said Llama 3 improved reasoning and coding capabilities over the earlier Llama 2 family.
Apple Inc acquired Beats Electronics in 2014 for approximately three billion dollars. The company later used the music business and technology as part of its broader services strategy.

AAPL developed Apple Silicon for Mac computers and introduced the M1 technology in November 2020. Apple said the processor integrated CPU, GPU, memory, and machine-learning components into a single system on a chip.

GOOGL developed TensorFlow and released the machine-learning technology as open-source software in November 2015. Google engineers originally built the system for internal research and production workloads.

Microsoft Corp uses Azure AI infrastructure to train and deploy machine-learning systems. Microsoft described Azure as a core technology supporting its partnerships and enterprise artificial-intelligence products.

Meta Platforms Inc uses PyTorch for artificial-intelligence research and production. The company developed the open-source technology internally before stewardship moved to the independent PyTorch Foundation.

GOOG partnered with Anthropic to use Google Cloud infrastructure for training and serving Claude models. The agreement followed Google's investment and connected the two companies through both capital and cloud technology.
